newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Spotsylvania County, Va..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Spotsylvania County, Va..

text.p: General Obligation School Bonds, Series of 1997

Sealed bids will be received by Wheat First Butcher Singer, Financial Advisor to the County of Spotsylvania, Virginia (the County''), on behalf of the County Board of Supervisors, until 11:00 a.m., Local Time, on
at the offices of Wheat First Butcher Singer, Riverfront Plaza, West Tower, 901 East Byrd Street, 4th Floor,
Richmond, Virginia 23219 (Attention:Public Finance Section), for the purchase of $22,255,000 General Obligation School Bonds, Series of 1997 (the

which time the bids will be publicly opened. The Bonds will be issued by means of a book-entry system with no distribution of physical bond certificates to the public. The Bonds will be issued in fully registered form in denominations of $5,000 or any multiple thereof. The Bonds will be dated January 1, 1997, will mature or be subject to mandatory sinking fund redemption on January 15 in each of the years 1998 to 2017, inclusive. Bonds maturing on or after January 15, 2008, will be callable on or after January 15, 2007, all as described in the County's detailed Notice of Sale. The Bonds will be general obligations of the County, secured by a pledge of its full faith and credit. The approving opinion of Hunton &Williams, Richmond,
Virginia, will be furnished to the successful bidder at the expense of the County.
Additional information, including the detailed Notice of Sale, the Official Bid Form and the Preliminary Official Statement, may be obtained from the Public Finance
Department, Wheat First Butcher Singer, 901 East Bryd Street, Richmond, Virginia 23219 (804-649-2311), Financial Advisor to the County.
By: L. Kimball Payne, III, County Administrator
